newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Monday, as private investors' short-covering lost steam in the afternoon session, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 1.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark March was 0.9 yen lower at 133.9 yen.
Activity was lacklustre amid a dearth of fresh incentives.

The market opened firmer on short-covering, but a lack of fresh buying and selling on any price rally pushed prices into negative territory at the close. "The market participants were disappointed to see that the early price rebound quickly stalled," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
